scholarships.name: International Student Scholarship
scholarships.description: Available for September 2026 entry to support students who make early tuition fee deposit. Applicable to most UG and PGT courses.

scholarships.name: Oxford Brookes Business School Scholarship
scholarships.description: £2,000 scholarship for selected Oxford Brookes Business School UG degrees for students making timely deposit payment.

scholarships.name: Global Development and Humanitarian Practice Scholarship
scholarships.description: Full/part-time scholarship for MA Global Development and Humanitarian Practice — for students from developing countries in Asia, Africa, Middle East, Latin America.

scholarships.name: Sanctuary Scholarship
scholarships.description: Full fee waiver plus £4,000 bursary and £10,000 accommodation support for asylum seekers / those with protection status. Includes guaranteed halls of residence.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarship
scholarships.description: Minimum £10,000 towards tuition for one-year postgraduate courses, in partnership with the British Council.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.description: 10–20% discount on tuition fees for Oxford Brookes alumni pursuing further study. Varies by level.

accommodation.name: Clive Booth Student Village
accommodation.text: Резиденция университета рядом с Headington Campus. 364 study bedrooms en suite. Контракт на 50 недель.

accommodation.name: Parade Green (Unite Students)
accommodation.text: 887 спален во флэтах, 1.5 мили от Headington. En-suite, 38-недельный контракт для первокурсников.

accommodation.name: Harcourt Hill Campus Halls
accommodation.text: 46 studio flats с en-suite на Harcourt Hill. 38–50-недельные контракты.

campuses.title: Headington Campus (Main)
campuses.text: Одна миля к востоку от центра Оксфорда. Три участка: Gipsy Lane (main), Headington Hill, Marston Road (Nursing & Health). Современные facilities для engineering, computing, architecture.

campuses.title: Harcourt Hill Campus
campuses.text: 3 мили от центра. Жильё + спортивные facilities. С 2025/26 преподавание перенесено в Headington.

paragraphs: Oxford Brookes University — современный университет в историческом Оксфорде, входит в топ-50 Великобритании (Complete University Guide 2025).
Особенно силён в архитектуре (топ-10 UK), Motorsport Engineering (выпускники — в Ferrari, Williams и командах F1), Hospitality, Business School (AACSB-аккредитация), Nursing, Computing.
Партнёрство с QA Higher Education открывает pathway-маршруты: International Foundation, Pre-Master's Diploma, Two-Year Master's.
Стипендии включают International Student Scholarship £2,000, Sanctuary Scholarship (для ищущих убежища) и GREAT (минимум £10,000).
